user: The moon has a surface area that is 1/5 that of Earth. The surface area of the Earth is 200 square acres. The land on the moon is worth 6 times that of the land on the Earth. \[

\]

The total value of all the land on Earth is 80 billion dollars, and the surface area of the Earth is 200 square acres:
\[
\text{Value of land per square acre on Earth} = \frac{80 \text{ billion}}{200 \text{ acres}} = 0.4 \text{ billion dollars per acre}
\]

\[
\text{Value of land per square acre on the moon} = 6 \times 0.4 \text{ billion dollars per acre} = 2.4 \text{ billion dollars per acre}
\]

**Step 4: Total Value of All the Land on the Moon**

\[
\text{Total value of all the land on the moon} = 40 \text{ acres} \times 2.4 \text{ billion dollars per acre} = 96 \text{ billion dollars}
\]

Thus, the total value in billions of all the land on the moon is \( \boxed{96} \).
